instruction: Make the card lift on hover.
input:
.card { transition: all 0.3s ease-in; }
.card:hover { transform: translateY(-4px); box-shadow: 0 16px 32px rgba(0,0,0,0.3); }

instruction: Animate the dropdown opening from its trigger.
input: .dropdown { opacity: 0; transform: scale(0); animation: pop 400ms ease-in; }
